name: Acme Supplier Mutual NDA (Demo)
text:
Confidentiality limited to specific defined information.

Notice of termination shall be provided thirty (30) days in writing prior to expiration.

The receiving party agrees to indemnify the disclosing party against any claims arising from unauthorized disclosure, with liability limited to direct damages not exceeding the value of the engagement.

Non-solicitation: neither party shall solicit employees, contractors, or affiliates of the other for a period of twenty-four (24) months following termination.

Residual knowledge retained in the unaided memory of authorised personnel is excluded from confidentiality, provided it does not encompass source code, pricing, product roadmaps, or personal data.
